title: Fantasy Blitz Configuration
description: An arcade-style NFL fantasy football show: top scorers, busts, big plays, waiver pickups, injuries and more. No league login needed.

scoring_format.description: How fantasy points are counted. PPR gives 1 point per catch, Half-PPR 0.5, Standard 0. Pick the one your league uses

top_n.description: How many of the week's top scorers get a player card

positions.title: Positions
positions.description: Which positions can appear on the screens

watchlist.description: Players to follow, one name each (e.g. 'Josh Allen'). Add a team if a name is shared ('Josh Allen BUF'). They get their own screen and big-play alerts at a lower threshold

show_headshots.description: Show player photos on the cards. When off, cards show a team-colour silhouette with the jersey number

live_priority.description: Let a big fantasy play interrupt the rotation for a few seconds while games are on

spoiler_delay_seconds.description: Hold live scores and big-play alerts back this many seconds, for watching on a delayed stream

display_duration.description: Seconds per screen when a screen's own duration is 0 and it has nothing to count

screens.title: Screens
screens.description: Turn each screen on or off. A duration of 0 means long enough to show everything on it

player_card.title: Player cards
player_card.description: This week's top scorers as collectible cards

duration.description: Seconds on screen (0 = one card every few seconds until all are shown)

big_play.title: Big play alerts
big_play.description: A celebration when a player gains a lot of points on one play, while games are live

dud_alert.title: Dud alerts
dud_alert.description: The players who fell furthest short of their projection, once their game is over

hot_pickups.title: Hot pickups
hot_pickups.description: The free agents fantasy players are adding most (hidden while games are live)

show_drops.description: Also show the players being dropped most

position_kings.title: Position kings
position_kings.description: The top scorer at each position on one screen

injury_report.title: Injury report
injury_report.description: Injury tags on the players who matter, before kickoff

watchlist.title: My players
watchlist.description: Live points for the players in your watchlist

weekly_awards.title: Weekly awards
weekly_awards.description: Tuesday and Wednesday trophy screens: MVP, bust, biggest boom and waiver hero

league_matchup.title: League matchups
league_matchup.description: Head-to-head scores from your own league (set it up under League)

enabled.description: Show league matchups when a league is set up

season_race.title: Season race
season_race.description: The season's top fantasy scorers so far

league.title: League
league.description: Optional: show the matchups from your own Sleeper or ESPN league. Yahoo is not supported (it requires an app sign-in a scoreboard cannot do)

league_id.description: Your league's id: the long number in the league's web address

team_name.description: Your team name or your username, so your matchup is shown first and marked YOU. Leave empty to show every matchup in turn

espn_s2.description: ESPN private leagues only: the espn_s2 cookie from a browser signed in to ESPN Fantasy

swid.description: ESPN private leagues only: the SWID cookie (it looks like {XXXXXXXX-...})

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Fine-tuning. The defaults suit most boards

big_play_min_points.description: Smallest jump in a player's points between two updates that counts as a big play

watchlist_min_points.description: The big-play threshold for watchlist players (usually lower)

bust_min_projection.description: Only players projected for at least this many points can be a dud

tier_thresholds.title: Card tiers
tier_thresholds.description: Points a card needs for each rarity colour

live_poll_seconds.description: Seconds between score refreshes while a game is live

idle_poll_seconds.description: Seconds between refreshes when no game is on

card_seconds.description: Seconds each card stays up before the next

animations.description: Animate the screens (count-ups, shimmer, confetti). Off draws each screen once, which is lighter on an older Pi

animation_fps.description: Frames per second for the animations

request_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for Sleeper or ESPN before giving up

headshot_downloads.description: Download player photos from ESPN. Off uses only photos already saved

vegas_mode.description: How Fantasy Blitz behaves in Vegas mode: scroll its top scorers through the ticker, scroll the whole panel as one block, or pause the ticker and show normally
